title: hearts_test.gd (villager heart arcs ♥2-10, ♥6 quests, daily lines) is not wired into check.sh, so heart arcs have no CI coverage; it is also penguin-only
repro: grep hearts_test tools/check.sh -> nothing. Ran it now: godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 -s res://tools/hearts_test.gd -> HEARTS DONE, failures: 0 (passes, just never run). It only does new_run("penguins").
fix: Add a check.sh block (own block, blank lines around, --fixed-fps 60, grep 'HEARTS DONE, failures: 0' and fail on SCRIPT ERROR). Extend hearts_test with a gangster pass: same 25-arc walk under ARC gangsters, plus asserts that a villager sent away by a story choice (posy_gone/lumi_gone/juniper_gone from g2_shop1/g4_shop2/g4_shop3) gets no due milestone (Hearts.due(id)==0) and is left out of Hearts.standing_with_you() and Epilogue villagers; assert ♥8 NEEDS_FLAG order (granite/bram/gideon/hazel) fails when the partner's ♥8 hasn't played; add seed(1) in _initialize.

title: Two of the four endings (penguin 'shatter' The Quiet Mountain, gangster 'take' The Chair) are never played: story_test always picks choice 0, and nothing asserts run.ending after the finale
repro: story_test._advance_all presses btns[0] at every choice, so p5_win/g5_win only take branch 0 (revert/free). No assert on GameState.run.ending, flags ending_*, dc_shattered/city_taken, or the p5_epilogue 'if_flag dc_shattered' line. systems_test only builds Epilogue slides for revert/free with hand-set run.ending.
fix: In story_test, snapshot GameState.run.duplicate(true) right before playing p5_win / g5_win. Play with pick 0 and assert run.ending=='revert'/'free', flags ending_revert/dc_reverted (penguins) or president_freed (gang), then play *_epilogue (sleep trigger) and assert flags epilogue_done and Epilogue.build()[0][0] contains 'Two Crystals'/'A Tired Man'. Restore the snapshot, replay with pick 1 (make _advance_all take a pick arg) and assert run.ending=='shatter'/'take', ending_revert/dc_reverted unflagged (p5_win unflag list), the epilogue shows the 'He wouldn't come home' line, Epilogue.build()[0][0] contains 'The Quiet Mountain'/'The Chair', and in 'take' a beaten lieutenant line reads 'takes orders from the tower again' and Marked lines mention the tower. Also assert fennimore_free only on branch 0 with fennimore_turnable set.

title: No test covers non-first story choices: deferral options ('Not yet', 'I'll come back') and failed gates must re-arm the recruit beat, and every branch-1/2 flag is untested
repro: Choices with effects_by_choice: p1_grump_truth, p2_locket, p3_knight_nova, p4_prison, g2_deuce(3), g2_rosa, g2_shop1, g3_marlene(_m), g4_dice(3), g4_doc, g4_shop2, g4_shop3. story_test picks 0 everywhere; gang_start_test picks 1 for Deuce/Rosa but never checks Rosa's beat comes back. Story._play_lines' gate-fail path (toast 'You don't have ◆150 yet', erases st_<beat>) has no test at all.
fix: Add a branch matrix to story_test: for each choice beat, snapshot run, then for every option i: restore, play the beat with pick i, assert run.decisions[key]==i and the option's effects_by_choice flags/unflags (kept_quiet, locket_keep, knight_fight, fennimore_sure, shop_N_refused, letter_safe+crew_marlene, deuce_thumb, dice_scared). For deferral options (g2_deuce 2, g2_rosa 1, g4_dice 2, g4_doc 1) assert Story.fired(beat)==false and Story._ready_beat(b,map) is true again, then replay with pick 0 and assert crew_<id>. For gated picks, set crystals 0 / no crops / no wild_herb and assert: not fired, crystals/crops/herbs unchanged, no crew flag, beat ready again. Assert g2_shop1 pick 0 adds posy_gone and drops Posy's friendship by 100.

title: story_test fabricates every beat condition (finishes the quest, sets the flags, sets the decision, recruits the companion), so a broken chain between beats can never fail it
repro: story_test._run: for each beat it calls _finish_quest(when.quest) even if the quest was never given, sets when.flags/flag, erases not_flags, sets decisions and st_<after>. A beat whose effects stop giving the next quest/flag (e.g. p4_gate needs quest teleporter from an earlier beat; g5_doors_* need quest pit) would still pass.
fix: Before forcing a condition, assert it is already reachable: for when.quest assert GameState.has_quest(q) (given by quests.json main chain or an earlier beat's effects.quest) before marking it done; for each when flag that some earlier beat's effects/effects_by_choice sets, assert it is already set and don't set it (keep an allow-list for world-made flags: *_seen, boss_*, mine_open_*, babies_calm, campfire_done, hp_below/day). For b.after assert Story.fired(after) instead of setting st_<after>. Assert Story.chapter_no() never goes down across the walk and reaches the last chapter at the end. For the mutually exclusive variants (g3_marlene vs g3_marlene_m by decision letter; g5_doors_letter/kept/kept_m/sasha/force) assert exactly one variant is ready for each decision set instead of forcing all of them.

title: Epilogue text consistency is unchecked: no static assert that epilogue.json choice keys/options match story choice keys and that every flag_line has a producer, and no per-option 'What you chose' check
repro: epilogue.json choices keys: tell_town, locket, fennimore, letter, photo, shop_1..3, sell_letter; story keys also include coldy_join, knight_mercy, deuce_join, rosa_join, dice_join, doc_join (no lines - may be fine) and 'letter' is set by the farm intro, not a story beat. flag_lines include proj_star_beacon (made only via Project grant 'proj_'+grant). Nothing fails if a key is renamed in story.json.
fix: In story_test (or a check in gen_epilogue.py), assert every epilogue choices key is a story choice 'key' or in an explicit allow-list ['letter'], every option index exists in that choice, and every flag_lines key is set somewhere (story effects, quests.json, or an allow-list for dynamic producers like proj_*). After the branch matrix, assert Epilogue.build()'s 'What you chose' slide contains the line for each decision taken.

title: The Epilogue screen itself has no runtime test: auto-play after epilogue_done, slide advance, B to skip, unpause and music hand-back, and Options > 'Replay the ending' (menu_sweep_test skips it)
repro: tools/menu_sweep_test.gd SKIP has 'Replay the ending'; no test sets epilogue_done and lets GameMap._process call Epilogue.play (flag epilogue_shown). Epilogue._process/_next/_close are only reached by players.
fix: New tools/epilogue_test.gd (--fixed-fps 60, seed): both arcs, set run.ending + flags epilogue_done on the farm map; assert within N frames Epilogue.showing, tree paused, flags epilogue_shown; press 'a' through all slides (respect _arm >= 10) and assert it closes after the last ('Thank you for playing'), tree unpaused, Hud.modal_rect empty, player can move; replay via GameMenu 'Replay the ending' and close with 'b' on slide 1; assert the epilogue does not auto-play twice after a scene change; run tools/ui_audit at 270x480 on one slide. Wire into check.sh as its own block.

title: Story-side tests break the C2 determinism rule and their check.sh blocks don't fail on SCRIPT ERROR
repro: check.sh runs story_test.gd and gang_start_test.gd without --fixed-fps 60; neither calls seed(n). newgame_penguin_test waits on create_timer(0.7/2.5/0.1). The story and gang blocks grep only the done line, so a SCRIPT ERROR inside a beat that doesn't abort it still passes (ran story_test now: 407 ok, 0 errors, so nothing hidden today).
fix: Add --fixed-fps 60 to both check.sh lines and seed(7) in each _initialize; replace create_timer waits in newgame_penguin_test with game-time frame loops (gt += get_process_delta_time()). In the story/gang/newgame blocks also fail when the output has 'SCRIPT ERROR' (grep -q and exit 1).

title: story_test asserts only 'ready' and 'fired' for each of the 56 beats: no beat's effects (quest given, items, flags, companion, scene_to, boss spawn) are checked in any chapter
repro: Ran all 4 story tests now under --fixed-fps 60: story_test 407 ok, campaign_story_test 104 ok, gang_start_test 22 ok, newgame_penguin_test 21 ok, 0 fails. story_test's per-beat checks are only check(ok,'beat X ready') and check(Story.fired(X)). Effects with no assert anywhere: p1_grump_truth (old_collar, quest cattopia), p1_howl (farm_bubble), p2_catkins (meow_taught, quest spark), p2_spark (catship_done, litter_box x5, quest wastes_gate), p2_locket (brass_locket, quest sky_stair), p2_finn_locket (brass_locket -1, finn_told), p3_campfire (campfire_done, 'know'), p3_babies (babies_fight + spawn), p3_coldy (coldy companion, sacred_key, babies_done), p3_knight_done (quest teleporter), p3_knight_fight_after (knight_shard, auk_shard), p3_knight_mercy_after (auk_ally), p4_prison (prison_done + scene_to lake 20,8), p4_merkitties (mer companion, merkitty_necklace), p4_tele (quest alder_gold), p4_bell_rung (bell_rung), p5_spire / g5_president (final_started, boss_card, spawn), p5_win / g5_win (final_done, heal, clear_kind finargle_elder/shard), g1_man (burner_phone, quest hideout), g1_sal (sal_recruited), g2_shop1 (quest docks), g3_manifest (manifest), g3_specs/ladder/halo, g4_twins (crew_vic+crew_val), g4_kid, g4_sasha (crew flags), g3_marlene(_m) (quest neon), g4_flame (quest pit), g5_doors_* (tower_open + tower_quiet|tower_loud, doors_by_*).
fix: Add one generic, data-driven assert block in story_test right after each beat fires (fx = b.effects): before playing, record item counts for fx.items and Companion.party().known; after: for f in fx.flags check(GameState.run.flags.has(f)); for u in fx.unflag check(not has); for [it,n] in fx.items check(count(it)==before+n); for [q,_] in fx.quest check(GameState.has_quest(q)); if fx.companion check(fx.companion in Companion.party().known); if fx.scene_to check((current_scene as GameMap).scene_id()==fx.scene_to[0]) and re-grab map; if fx.spawn check(map.enemies.size()>=fx.spawn.size()) and for boss_card check DangerMusic tier 4 or map has the boss kind; if fx.heal check(hp==max_hp); if fx.clear_kind check no live enemy of those kinds. For crew_* flags also check(Crew.recruited(id)). For g5_win (gang) check the first lines played include one Crew 'finale' line per recruited crew member that has one.

title: Alternate-path beats are forced together or skipped: g4_dice_knows is counted as played without ever playing; mercy/fight knight outcomes, p5_bitter vs p5_auk, g3_marlene_burned/late are all forced in one run so their exclusivity and epilogue effects are never checked
repro: story_test: `if not ok and id.ends_with('_knows'): played += 1; continue` - g4_dice_knows (talk dice, when president_knows, not crew_dice; sets dice_refused) never plays. p3_knight_mercy_after needs knight_reverted, p3_knight_fight_after needs not knight_reverted: the test sets then erases the flag so both play, and the epilogue's companions_if Nova line (knight_reverted) and flag_line auk_shard are never compared. p5_bitter (bitter_left) and p5_auk (auk_ally) both play. g3_marlene_burned (decision letter 0) and g3_marlene_late (tower_open, letter not decided) both play next to g3_marlene/_m.
fix: Replace forced play with path runs from snapshots: (1) Knight: snapshot before p3_knight_nova; path A pick 0 + set knight_reverted (Meow Pow Wow win) -> check p3_knight_mercy_after ready, p3_knight_fight_after NOT ready, auk_ally set, then at the finale p5_auk ready; Epilogue.build() Nova line is the companions_if text. Path B pick 1 -> fight_after ready, mercy_after not, knight_shard +1, auk_shard set, p5_auk not ready, epilogue has the auk_shard flag line. (2) Dice: path with g3_marlene pick 0 (president_knows) and no crew_dice -> g4_dice not ready, g4_dice_knows ready, plays, dice_refused set, Crew.recruited('dice') false. (3) Letter: for decision letter 0/1/2 check exactly one of g3_marlene_burned/g3_marlene/g3_marlene_m is ready after boss_docks, and g3_marlene_late is ready only with tower_open and no letter_decided. (4) p5_bitter: set bitter_left, check Companion.party().bitter non-empty and that companion's 'Who stayed' line is absent from Epilogue.build(). Remove the '_knows' skip so played==beats.size() means every beat really played on some path.

title: Heart scenes: hearts_test checks only seen_level/daily per milestone; the if_gone line variants, the ♥6 'fall' hint, and 25 of the 26 villagers' heart perks (data/heart_perks.json) have no assert
repro: hearts_test asserts Hearts.due==n, seen_level==n, daily!='' and the ♥6 quest offer. Not asserted: Hearts.talk's 'if_gone' text swap (2 lines in hearts.json, used when <who>_gone is set by gangster shop choices), the 'fall' hint Hearts adds (GameState.add_hint '<name>: <fall>'), and Perks.check(npc): systems_test only checks Ivy's no_clinic_fee flag and one Perks.morning call. There is no romance/marriage system at all: heart arcs are friendship-only.
fix: In hearts_test, per villager after each milestone: lines = Perks.check(id); if heart_perks[id] has str(n): check(lines.size()==1 and lines[0].begins_with('♥%d' % n)), check every 'give' item count rose by its amount (#gold -> crystals, #tickets -> Tickets, #seedpack -> 5 seeds of Perks.seed_pack()), every 'bonus' stat rose in run['bonus_'+stat]; then check(Perks.check(id).is_empty()) (no double gift). For 'season' perks set day to a season start and check Perks.morning() lists it once. For the 2 if_gone lines: set <who>_gone, play that milestone and check the dialogue shows the if_gone text. After ♥6 check the hints include the villager's 'fall' text.
needs_tom: Heart arcs are friendship-only; there is no romance/dating/marriage system. Confirm that is intended (all-ages game), so no romance asserts are needed.

title: New-game tests stop early and miss chapter-1 story asserts: gang_start_test never checks g1_man's photo choice/burner_phone/quest hideout or sal_recruited; newgame_penguin_test never reaches p1_town, p1_howl or p1_grump_truth; campaign_story_test unlocks campaigns with Campaign._unlock instead of the story beat that follows
repro: Only campaign_story_test and goal_line_test even mention these ids/flags, and only as state they set by hand. gang_start_test picks 0 at g1_man (photo burned) with no assert. newgame_penguin_test ends on day 2 at the farm. campaign_story_test calls Campaign._unlock(named) and marks quests done by hand, so it never checks the story beat for the opened region (e.g. p3_mountain on quest commander, g4_arrive at neon) is ready right after.
fix: gang_start_test after the coat scene: check(GameState.run.decisions.photo==0), check(GameState.count('burner_phone')==1), check(GameState.has_quest('hideout')), and after Sal's tour talk check(flags.has('sal_recruited')). newgame_penguin_test: continue to town on day 2 -> check Story.fired('p1_town'); sleep to day 3, walk into farm rect (20,8,10,6) -> check Story.fired('p1_howl') and flags.farm_bubble; finish clear_meadow via Story.on_quest_done -> check p1_grump_truth played, decisions.tell_town set, old_collar x1, has_quest('cattopia'). campaign_story_test after each region opens: for beats with trigger.scene in that region and when.quest == qid, check(Story._ready_beat(b, null-safe map) or GameState._cond_ok(b.when)) so the story continues past each campaign.
